en: It's your turn.\f
cz: Jsi na tahu.\f

en: Even regaining two HP per day,\rwe're not going to be ready in time.\f
cz: I kdyz denne dostaneme dve HP,\rnestihneme to vcas.\f

en: Great! Put the cursor here and\rmove to this spot.\f
cz: Vyborne! Dej kurzor sem a\rpresun se na toto misto.\f

en: The Blue Moon forces\rhave retreated!\fCapturing this area was vital\rto our strategy.\fYou did a great job!\fKeep up the good work.\f
cz: Jednotky Blue Moon\rustoupily!\fObsazeni teto oblasti bylo\rpro nasi strategii klicove.\fOdvedl jsi skvelou praci!\fJen tak dal.\f

en: Nell?\fSo, she does have her hand in this!\fThat explains why this little group\rhas been such unexpected trouble.\fThis is unforgivable! Next time, I\rwill give them a display of true might!\fMark my words!\f
cz: Nell?\fTakze v tom ma prsty ona!\fTo vysvetluje, proc ta mala skupinka\rdela tak necekane potize.\fTo je neodpustitelne! Priste jim\rpredvedu skutecnou silu!\fPamatujte si ma slova!\f

en: You lost. That's too bad.\fBetter luck next time.\f
cz: Prohral jsi. To je skoda.\fPriste budes mit vic stesti.\f

en: OK. Will you select this unit\rand move it here, please?\f
cz: Dobre. Vyber prosim tuto jednotku\ra presun ji sem.\f

en: Would you please move the\runit to this position?\f
cz: Presunes prosim jednotku\rna tuto pozici?\f

en: also provide supplies simultaneously\rto any unit adjacent to it.\f
cz: zaroven doplnuje zasoby\rvsem sousednim jednotkam.\f

en: Thank you. Now, press the A Button\ragain to display the Command Menu.\f
cz: Diky. Ted znovu stiskni tlacitko A\ra zobraz nabidku prikazu.\f

en: Please move the unit here.\f
cz: Presun prosim jednotku sem.\f

en: It will be easier to deploy this unit\rfrom a point near this base,\fso please deploy it to this position.\f
cz: Tuto jednotku snadneji nasadis\rz mista blizko zakladny,\ftakze ji nasad na tuto pozici.\f

en: to this point.\f
cz: na toto misto.\f

en: We need to move it\rtoward the base.\fWould you move it here, please?\f
cz: Musime ji presunout\rsmerem k zakladne.\fPresunes ji prosim sem?\f

en: Grrr... Curse you, Nell!\fLooks like you're bound and\rdetermined to get in my way!\fI'll have my troops swat\ryou like a fly!\f
cz: Grrr... At te vezme cert, Nell!\fVypada to, ze jsi rozhodnuta\rplest se mi do cesty!\fMe jednotky te rozplacnou\rjako mouchu!\f

en: OK. Now move the\runit here, please.\f
cz: Dobre. Ted presun\rjednotku sem.\f

en: Let's move this unit.\fWould you select it, please?\f
cz: Presuneme tuto jednotku.\fVyberes ji prosim?\f

en: Please move the unit to\rthis space.\f
cz: Presun prosim jednotku\rna toto pole.\f

en: Please move it here. Remember\rto press the A Button.\f
cz: Presun ji prosim sem. Nezapomen\rstisknout tlacitko A.\f

en: Please unload the unit\rinto this space.\fUse the + Control Pad\rto select this space, please.\f
cz: Vylod prosim jednotku\rna toto pole.\fPouzij ovladaci krizek\ra vyber toto pole.\f

en: First of all, you need to protect\rthese two cities.\f
cz: Nejdriv musis ochranit\rtato dve mesta.\f

en: Grrr...\fNext time, blast it! Next time!\f
cz: Grrr...\fPriste, hrom do toho! Priste!\f

en: It's too bad, but you lost.\fI have a feeling you'll win next\rtime though. Good luck!\f
cz: Je to skoda, ale prohral jsi.\fMam pocit, ze priste vyhrajes.\rHodne stesti!\f

en: Ha, ha, ha! I see you've failed\rto notice my new weapons, Nell!\fYou'll soon tremble before the power\rof the mightiest ground forces ever!\f
cz: Cha, cha, cha! Vidim, ze sis\rnevsimla mych novych zbrani, Nell!\fBrzy se budes trast pred silou\rnejmocnejsi pozemni armady vubec!\f

en: Olaf is one shrewd guy.\fLook at the units he's deployed.\rHe's always one step ahead of us.\f
cz: Olaf je vychytraly chlap.\fPodivej se, co vsechno nasadil.\rPorad je o krok pred nami.\f

en: I didn't think he'd have any air units.\rI guess I underestimated him again.\f
cz: Necekal jsem, ze ma letecke jednotky.\rZase jsem ho podcenil.\f

en: No, not that unit.\fSelect this unit, please.\f
cz: Ne, tuhle jednotku ne.\fVyber prosim tuto.\f

en: The enemy HQ is right below you.\f
cz: Nepratelske HQ je primo pod tebou.\f

en: OK, let's move it down here.\f
cz: Dobre, presuneme ji sem dolu.\f

en: Do you think you could move it\rhere?\f
cz: Mohl bys ji prosim presunout\rsem?\f

en: Good luck!\fI'm counting on you!\f
cz: Hodne stesti!\fSpoleham na tebe!\f

en: What in the...\fMy HQ has been stormed!\fNell, you troublesome little...\fYou saw that you couldn't survive\ra frontal assault, and so you pull\fthis out of your hat!\rGrrr...\fThis isn't over yet!\f
cz: Co to...\fMe HQ bylo obsazeno!\fNell, ty protivna mala...\fVidela jsi, ze celni utok\rneprezijes, a tak jsi vytahla\ftohle eso z rukavu!\rGrrr...\fJeste neni konec!\f

en: You routed the enemy?\fAmazing!\fI have to admit, I didn't\rthink you could destroy them all!\fKeep up the good work! Outstanding!\f
cz: Rozprasil jsi nepritele?\fUzasne!\fMusim uznat, ze jsem necekala,\rze je dokazes znicit vsechny!\fJen tak dal! Vynikajici prace!\f

en: All of my beautiful units...gone?\fImpossible!\fNell couldn't possibly do this\ron her own.\fGrrr...\fThis isn't over yet!\f
cz: Vsechny me krasne jednotky...pryc?\fTo je nemozne!\fTohle by Nell nikdy nedokazala\rsama.\fGrrr...\fJeste neni konec!\f

en: A frontal assault on so many enemies\rmakes for pretty tough odds...\fAs long as you don't forget to\rtake over the HQ, things should\fimprove. Better luck next time!\f
cz: Celni utok na tolik nepratel\rjsou dost mizerne sance...\fKdyz nezapomenes obsadit HQ,\rpujde to o dost lip.\fPriste budes mit vic stesti!\f

en: Ha ha ha!\fNell! Mobilizing your troops\ragain, are you?\fWell, you're too late!\fFly, my masters of the sky!\fFinish off these surviving troops, then\rdestroy that meddlesome Nell's units!\f
cz: Cha cha cha!\fNell! Zase mobilizujes\rsve jednotky?\fJenze je pozde!\fLette, moji panove oblohy!\fDorazte ty prezivsi jednotky a pak\rznicte jednotky te otravne Nell!\f

en: We forgot to refill the fuel tanks?\fWhat are you fools thinking???\fIs it that hard to refuel an aircraft?\fAugh!!!\fJust wait until next time!\f
cz: Zapomneli jsme doplnit palivo?\fCo si to vy hlupaci myslite???\fJe tak tezke natankovat letadlo?\fAaach!!!\fJen pockejte priste!\f

en: You've assembled a pretty\rwell-balanced army.\f
cz: Poskladal jsi docela\rvyvazenou armadu.\f

en: But since they're across the sea, you\rcan't easily attack them.\f
cz: Jenze jsou za morem, takze na ne\rjen tak nezautocis.\f

en: Now is our chance to test them.\fSelect this unit, please.\f
cz: Ted je sance je vyzkouset.\fVyber prosim tuto jednotku.\f

en: Do you remember what to do when\ryou have multiple potential targets?\fThat's right! Use the + Control Pad\rto choose one.\f
cz: Pamatujes si, co delat, kdyz\rmas vic moznych cilu?\fPresne tak! Ovladacim krizkem\rjeden vyberes.\f

en: Well done! I knew you'd do it!\fI don't need to tell you anything\rmore! Why don't you see how quickly\fyou can clear this map? Ten days is\fa good benchmark, but if you're really\rgood, you could do it in five.\fWell, good luck!\fI'm counting on you!\f
cz: Vyborne! Vedela jsem, ze to zvladnes!\fUz ti nemusim nic dalsiho\rrikat! Co takhle zkusit, jak rychle\ftuhle mapu zvladnes? Deset dni je\fdobra meta, ale kdyz jsi opravdu\rdobry, zvladnes to za pet.\fTak hodne stesti!\fSpoleham na tebe!\f

en: What?!?\fYou cleared this map that quickly???\fIncredible!\fI'm impressed at how far you've\rdeveloped your skills!\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Coze?!?\fTy jsi tuhle mapu zvladl tak rychle???\fNeuveritelne!\fJsem ohromena, jak moc\rses zlepsil!\fJen tak dal!\f

en: Well done!\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Vyborne!\fJen tak dal!\f

en: Augh!!! I never had\ra chance this time!\fNELL!!!\fJust wait until next time!\f
cz: Aaach!!! Tentokrat jsem\rnemel sanci!\fNELL!!!\fJen pockej priste!\f

en: What's this?!?\fThey found my landing forces?\fAugh! There's no way around it!\fWe'll have to make due with what\rwe've got!\f
cz: Co to?!?\fNasli moje vylodovaci jednotky?\fAaach! Neni zbyti!\fMusime si vystacit s tim,\rco mame!\f

en: Incredible!\fI can't believed you cleared this map\rin just two days!\fSomeone with your skills may even\rbe able to earn the "S" ranking in\fCampaigns, War Room...maybe even\rthe Advanced Campaign!\fYou might enjoy the challenge!\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Neuveritelne!\fNemuzu uverit, ze jsi tuhle mapu\rzvladl za pouhe dva dny!\fS takovym umenim mozna ziskas\rhodnoceni "S" v Tazeni,\fValecne mistnosti...mozna i\rv Pokrocilem tazeni!\fTa vyzva by te mohla bavit!\fJen tak dal!\f

en: What?!?\fYou cleared this map in three days?\fIncredible!\fI'm very impressed that you've\rdeveloped your skills so much!\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Coze?!?\fZvladl jsi tuhle mapu za tri dny?\fNeuveritelne!\fJsem nadsena, jak moc\rses zlepsil!\fJen tak dal!\f

en: Well done!\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Vyborne!\fJen tak dal!\f

en: Augh!!! How could my landing forces\rbe defeated?!?\fNow I'm in trouble!\fJust wait until next time!\f
cz: Aaach!!! Jak mohly me vylodovaci\rjednotky prohrat?!?\fTed mam potize!\fJen pockej priste!\f

en: Air units use fuel every day, so if\ryou don't refuel them, they'll crash.\fYou just have to stand tall and\rattack here. Better luck next time!\f
cz: Letecke jednotky kazdy den pali\rpalivo, a bez doplneni spadnou.\fTady se musis vzchopit a\rzautocit. Priste to vyjde!\f

en: If you leave the copter here, it'll be\rdestroyed immediately.\f
cz: Kdyz tu vrtulnik nechas, hned\rho znici.\f

en: Hurry up and get it out of there!\fCan you select it?\f
cz: Rychle ho odtud dostan!\fVyberes ho?\f

en: At first glance, it doesn't look like\rthere's anywhere it can pull back to...\fBut there is a way to save it!\f
cz: Na prvni pohled to vypada, ze\rnema kam ustoupit...\fPresto se da zachranit!\f

en: Move it here!\f
cz: Presun ho sem!\f

en: That took longer to explain than I\rthought it would.\fWell, let's move on to the\rnext unit's capabilities.\f
cz: Vysvetlovani trvalo dele,\rnez jsem cekala.\fTak pojdme na schopnosti\rdalsi jednotky.\f

en: Select this unit.\f
cz: Vyber tuto jednotku.\f

en: Move it over here.\f
cz: Presun ji sem.\f

en: So, we've got a naval battle on our\rhands here, eh?\fIf Nell hadn't taken out my air units,\rvictory would be much easier...\fBut they can't use most of their\rtroops, so that puts us on equal\ffooting. To battle!\f
cz: Takze nas ceka namorni bitva,\rco?\fKdyby Nell neznicila ma letadla,\rvitezstvi by bylo snazsi...\fJenze oni vetsinu svych jednotek\rpouzit nemuzou, takze jsme na tom\fstejne. Do boje!\f

en: It's your turn.\f
cz: Jsi na tahu.\f

en: This was a very strategic point for\rOlaf to attack Orange Star.\fThanks to you, we managed to\rblock his assault! Thank you!\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Tohle misto bylo pro Olafuv utok\rna Orange Star klicove.\fDiky tobe se nam podarilo\rjeho utok zastavit! Dekuji!\fJen tak dal!\f

en: I never expected them to make it\rthis far...\fAugh!!! Just wait until next time!\f
cz: Necekal jsem, ze se dostanou\raz sem...\fAaach!!! Jen pockejte priste!\f

en: I have a bad feeling about this.\fIt looks like Olaf...\rhas been waiting for us.\fIf we let him use his power,\rthere'll be trouble.\fLet's take him out all at once!\fI'm going to leave this one up\rto you! Good luck!\f
cz: Mam z toho spatny pocit.\fVypada to, ze Olaf...\rna nas cekal.\fKdyz ho nechame pouzit silu,\rbude zle.\fSlozme ho jednim uderem!\fTuhle bitvu necham na tobe!\rHodne stesti!\f

en: Ha ha ha! I've been waiting for you.\fNow I shall unleash my power!\fHeavens, hear my cry!\fBLIZZARD!!!\f
cz: Cha cha cha! Uz jsem vas cekal.\fTed rozpoutam svou silu!\fNebesa, slyste muj hlas!\fBLIZARD!!!\f

en: It's Olaf's CO Power!\fThis is what he's been waiting for...\fWe've been caught in his trap!\fEvery CO has his or her own special\rpower--a CO Power.\fWhen Olaf uses his CO Power, a huge\rsnow storm drops in. It's devastating!\fBut I can't use my CO Power right\rnow.\fI'm sorry.\fThere's one more thing...\fOlaf is very adept in the snow.\fIt's this power that caught\rBlue Moon's eye.\fSnow lowers the movement\rrange of all units.\f
cz: To je Olafova CO sila!\fNa tohle cekal...\fPadli jsme do jeho pasti!\fKazdy velitel ma svou zvlastni\rschopnost -- CO silu.\fKdyz Olaf pouzije CO silu, prijde\robrovska snehova boure. Je nicive!\fJa ale svou CO silu ted pouzit\rnemuzu.\fOmlouvam se.\fJeste jedna vec...\fOlaf si ve snehu skvele vede.\fPrave proto si ho Blue Moon\rvsiml.\fSnih snizuje dosah pohybu\rvsech jednotek.\f

en: This has turned into a rough battle.\fBut it should stop snowing after a\rfew days.\fJust be patient and try to\rhold out until then.\f
cz: Z tohohle je drsna bitva.\fZa par dni by ale melo\rprestat snezit.\fBud trpelivy a snaz se\rdo te doby vydrzet.\f

en: Huh?\fThe snow stopped!!!\fAugh! I don't have enough time to\rbuild up my power again...\fBut...I must have put fear into their\rhearts! Go, my soldiers!\fDon't give them time to regroup!\fDefeat them all!\f
cz: Coze?\fSnezit prestalo!!!\fAaach! Nemam dost casu, abych\rsvou silu znovu nabral...\fAle...urcite jsem jim nahnal\rstrach! Vpred, vojaci!\fNedejte jim cas se seskupit!\fPorazte je vsechny!\f

en: You held out long enough!\fThe snow has stopped!\fYou'd better watch out, though...\rOlaf still has plenty of units.\fYou must regroup!\f
cz: Vydrzel jsi dost dlouho!\fSnezit prestalo!\fAle pozor...\rOlaf ma porad spoustu jednotek.\fMusis se preskupit!\f

en: It's started raining!\fThis is a real blessing!\fRain slows movement a little bit.\fMore importantly, rain punishes Olaf.\fHe'll be brought to a virtual standstill!\fYou have to move now!\fTake him out in one swift blow!\f
cz: Zacalo prset!\fTo je hotove pozehnani!\fDest trochu zpomaluje pohyb.\fHlavne ale Olafovi skodi.\fPrakticky se uplne zastavi!\fTed musis jednat!\fSloz ho jednim rychlym uderem!\f

en: What's this?\fIt's started raining???\fAugh!!!\fOur spirits will have to carry us!\f
cz: Co to?\fZacalo prset???\fAaach!!!\fBude nas muset nest bojovy duch!\f

en: Each CO has a unique special ability.\fIn Olaf's case, he works well\rin snow, but he's susceptible to rain.\fRegardless of that, you were\rgreat this time!\fIf you can win the next battle,\rthen I'll have taught you all I can.\fI think the next battle will be our\rlast one together.\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Kazdy velitel ma vlastni schopnost.\fOlafovi jde skvele snih,\rale dest mu vadi.\fI presto sis dnes vedl\rskvele!\fJestli vyhrajes dalsi bitvu,\rnaucila jsem te uz vsechno.\fMyslim, ze dalsi bitva bude nase\rposledni spolecna.\fJen tak dal!\f

en: Even my trap didn't work...\fIf... If I don't win soon, they'll get back\rall the land I went to the trouble of\fcapturing.\fAugh!!! Just wait until next time!\f
cz: Ani ma past nezabrala...\fKdyz... Kdyz brzy nevyhraju, vezmou si\rzpatky vsechnu pudu, kterou jsem\fs namahou dobyl.\fAaach!!! Jen pockejte priste!\f

en: Olaf's power causes it to snow.\fWhen it snows, you lose your\reffectiveness.\fJust try to group up as much\ras you can.\fBetter luck next time.\f
cz: Olafova sila privolava snih.\fVe snehu ztracis\rucinnost.\fSnaz se drzet jednotky\rco nejvic pohromade.\fPriste budes mit vic stesti.\f

en: What a terrible view! The surrounding\rarea is almost completely hidden.\fThis phenomenon is known\ras Fog of War.\fWhen it is present, units can only\rsee a limited distance.\fCheck each unit's vision range to\rascertain the distance it can see.\f
cz: Hrozny vyhled! Okoli je skoro\rcele skryte.\fTomuhle jevu se rika\rMlha valky.\fJednotky pak vidi jen\rna omezenou vzdalenost.\fU kazde jednotky si zkontroluj\rdosah jejiho videni.\f

en: The other lit areas are around your\rHQ, your cities, and other positions.\fThey're lit to lead you to them.\fThe areas around neutral cities or\renemy positions aren't, though.\fThey stay dark until you draw\rclose to them.\f
cz: Osvetlena mista jsou kolem tveho\rHQ, tvych mest a dalsich pozic.\fSviti, aby te k nim dovedla.\fOkoli neutralnich mest a\rnepratelskych pozic ale ne.\fZustanou tmava, dokud se\rk nim nepriblizis.\f

en: Move it over here.\f
cz: Presun ji sem.\f

en: These cities looked the same\rwhen they were dark, didn't they?\fWhen checking a city's allegiance,\rI suggest approaching with caution.\f
cz: Ve tme vypadala tahle mesta\ruplne stejne, ze?\fKdyz zjistujes, komu mesto patri,\rradim ti opatrny pristup.\f

en: Move it over here.\f
cz: Presun ji sem.\f

en: When you have a larger vision range,\rit's much easier to spot enemies.\f
cz: S vetsim dosahem videni je\rmnohem snazsi najit nepratele.\f

en: Oh, yes. Did you notice that this\rarea here is still dark?\fThat's because you can't see into\rwoods unless you're adjacent to them.\f
cz: Aha, vsiml sis, ze tahle oblast\rje porad tmava?\fDo lesa totiz nevidis,\rdokud nestojis hned vedle nej.\f

en: By the way, reefs are the same. They\rremain dark until you're next to them.\f
cz: S utesy je to stejne. Zustanou\rtmave, dokud nejsi hned u nich.\f

en: Let's go back a moment.\f
cz: Vratme se na chvili zpatky.\f

en: There could actually be something\rin this forest.\fWhy don't you send\ra unit to scout it out?\f
cz: V tomhle lese fakt neco\rbyt muze.\fCo takhle poslat\rjednotku na pruzkum?\f

en: You can move here or here to\rcheck the forest.\fMove it to one of those spaces.\f
cz: Les prozkoumas z tohoto\rnebo z tohoto mista.\fPresun ji na jedno z nich.\f

en: Now, another thing on the subject\rof forests and reefs.\fThis time, the enemy was using the\rterrain to conceal its troops, right?\fWell, you can do the same thing! Using\rthe terrain to hide is a good strategy.\fOf course, you'll be spotted if the\renemy moves next to you, but...\fDid you get all that?\fI told you before, if you need intel,\ruse the cursor and the R Button.\fPress the R Button, then use the\r+ Control Pad to read the intel.\fThis is the way to check out different\rterrains, including woods and reefs.\f
cz: Jeste jedna vec k lesum\ra utesum.\fNepritel ted vyuzival teren\rke skryti svych jednotek, ze?\fTy muzes delat to same! Skryvat se\rv terenu je dobra strategie.\fJasne, kdyz se nepritel postavi\rhned vedle tebe, uvidi te, ale...\fRozumis vsemu?\fRikala jsem ti, ze informace\rziskas kurzorem a tlacitkem R.\fStiskni tlacitko R a pak si\rovladacim krizkem precti data.\fTakhle si prohlednes ruzne\rtereny, vcetne lesu a utesu.\f

en: I'm going to leave the rest of this\rbattle to you. Good luck!\f
cz: Zbytek teto bitvy nechavam\rna tobe. Hodne stesti!\f

en: So, they've taken back most of the\rOrange Star territory...\fI'll concede this day,\rbut the real battle is yet to come!\f
cz: Takze vetsinu uzemi Orange Star\rzase ziskali zpatky...\fTenhle den vam prenecham,\rale prava bitva teprve prijde!\f

en: Well done!\fYou've finally driven Olaf off!\f
cz: Vyborne!\fKonecne jsi Olafa zahnal!\f

en: Andy! Come here!\f
cz: Andy! Pojd sem!\f

en: Nell! What is it?\f
cz: Nell! Co se deje?\f

en: Be prepared, Andy can be\ra bit of a wiseacre.\f
cz: Pripravte se, Andy umi byt\rtrochu chytrak.\f

en: Well, good luck!\f
cz: Tak hodne stesti!\f

en: This is where I'll teach you some new\rcommands and other useful tidbits.\fSome of it may overlap with other\rthings I've taught you, though.\fSo, if you'd like to skip this\rlesson, just reset the game.\fTo reset, press START, SELECT,\rand the A and B Buttons at once.\fI'm going to begin now, OK?\fI'll explain a few things we haven't\rtouched on yet.\fI hope you'll try them all out.\f
cz: Tady te naucim nove prikazy\ra dalsi uzitecne drobnosti.\fNeco se mozna bude kryt s tim,\rco uz jsem te ucila.\fJestli chces tuhle lekci\rpreskocit, restartuj hru.\fRestartujes stiskem START, SELECT\ra tlacitek A a B naraz.\fZacinam, ano?\fVysvetlim par veci, ktere jsme\rjeste neprobrali.\fDoufam, ze si je vsechny zkusis.\f

en: When you want to move it over here,\ryou just move the cursor in a straight\fline and press the A Button, right?\f
cz: Kdyz ji chces presunout sem,\rposunes kurzor rovnou carou\fa stisknes tlacitko A, ze?\f

en: But right now there's an enemy here\rthat you can't see.\f
cz: Jenze tady je nepritel,\rktereho nevidis.\f

en: If you move in a straight line,\ryou'll run into it.\f
cz: Kdyz pujdes rovnou carou,\rnarazis do nej.\f

en: But pay attention to the red line that\rappears when you move the cursor.\fIt follows the cursor's path.\fDo you know what this means?\f
cz: Vsimni si cervene cary, ktera se\robjevi, kdyz hybes kurzorem.\fSleduje drahu kurzoru.\fVis, co to znamena?\f

en: This actually shows your unit's\rmovement direction.\f
cz: Ukazuje to smer pohybu\rtve jednotky.\f

en: So, your unit follows this path\rwhen it moves.\f
cz: Jednotka se pri pohybu\rvyda touhle cestou.\f

en: If you move the line over\rthis way, you'll be fine.\f
cz: Kdyz caru vedes tudy,\rbude to v poradku.\f

en: Just move the cursor like this!\f
cz: Staci hybat kurzorem takhle!\f

en: Try it out yourself.\f
cz: Zkus si to sam.\f

en: Move it over here.\f
cz: Presun ji sem.\f

en: No, I wanted you to move it\rover here.\f
cz: Ne, chtela jsem ji presunout\rsem.\f

en: That's it!\fThis is very handy in Fog of War\rsituations, so keep it in mind.\f
cz: Presne tak!\fV Mlze valky se to hodne hodi,\rtak na to nezapomen.\f

en: Uh-oh! You encountered an enemy...\fWhen a unit runs into an enemy,\rits turn automatically ends.\fThis, of course, can\rbe very dangerous.\fWhen you know an enemy is hiding\rnearby, avoid him with this technique.\f
cz: Ale ne! Narazil jsi na nepritele...\fKdyz jednotka narazi na nepritele,\rjeji tah automaticky skonci.\fTo muze byt\rhodne nebezpecne.\fKdyz vis, ze se nekdo skryva blizko,\rvyhni se mu touhle technikou.\f

en: Oh, unit data?\fThis gives you detailed information\rabout all of your units in the field.\fBut I've already told you that,\rhaven't I?\fYou can change what information\ryou see by moving the cursor.\fOh! One more thing...\fHave you ever wanted information\rabout the terrain the unit is on?\fJust press the R Button once more\rto view it! Try it yourself.\f
cz: Aha, data jednotek?\fUkazuji podrobne informace\ro vsech tvych jednotkach v poli.\fTo uz jsem ti ale\rrikala, ze?\fPohybem kurzoru zmenis,\rktere informace vidis.\fAha! Jeste jedna vec...\fChtel jsi nekdy informace\ro terenu, na kterem jednotka stoji?\fStaci znovu stisknout tlacitko R\ra uvidis je! Zkus si to.\f

en: The L Button, huh?\fThe L Button moves the cursor to\runits you haven't moved yet.\fThe Field Training maps have been\rsmall, so you haven't really needed it.\fOf course, the War Room and\rCampaign maps can be much larger...\fYou'll probably want to spread\ryour units out all over the map.\fThat's when it's quicker to use the\rL Button than to move the cursor.\fGive it a try!\f
cz: Tlacitko L, ano?\fTlacitko L presune kurzor na\rjednotky, kterymi jsi jeste nehnul.\fMapy Vycviku byly male,\rtakze jsi ho moc nepotreboval.\fMapy ve Valecne mistnosti a\rv Tazeni ale byvaji mnohem vetsi...\fNejspis budes chtit jednotky\rrozmistit po cele mape.\fPak je rychlejsi pouzit tlacitko L\rnez posouvat kurzor.\fZkus si to!\f

en: Terrain data...\fThis is where you get detailed\rinformation about the terrain.\fYou can check things like terrain\rcover and city income.\fMovement Cost shows a unit's\rmovement over the selected terrain.\fIt's easiest to view when it's\rcombined with unit data.\fOh, I almost forgot!\fYou can switch between terrain\rdetails and movement cost easily...\fJust press up and down\ron the + Control Pad.\f
cz: Data terenu...\fTady ziskas podrobne\rinformace o terenu.\fZkontrolujes treba kryti terenu\rnebo prijem z mesta.\fCena pohybu ukazuje pohyb\rjednotky po zvolenem terenu.\fNejlepe se to cte spolu\rs daty jednotek.\fAha, malem bych zapomnela!\fMezi detaily terenu a cenou\rpohybu prepnes snadno...\fStaci stisknout nahoru a dolu\rna ovladacim krizku.\f

en: Look at this...\fDo you see Type, HP, Gas, and\rRds (Rounds) all lined up here?\f
cz: Podivej se...\fVidis tu vedle sebe Typ, HP, Palivo\ra Muni (munice)?\f

en: Right now, the cursor is on Type.\fYou can press left and right on the\r+ Control Pad to choose a menu!\fTry it out.\f
cz: Kurzor je ted na polozce Typ.\fVlevo a vpravo na ovladacim krizku\rvyberes nabidku!\fZkus si to.\f

en: Then choose another menu.\f
cz: Tak vyber jinou nabidku.\f

en: Then choose another menu.\f
cz: Tak vyber jinou nabidku.\f

en: Like us--the Orange Star army.\f
cz: Jako my -- armada Orange Star.\f

en: A capture rate of 77% means we've\rcaptured 77% of the cities we\fcould possibly capture.\f
cz: Obsazeni 77% znamena, ze mame\r77% ze vsech mest, ktera\fjde vubec obsadit.\f

en: Income shows how much money we get\reach day from the cities we captured.\f
cz: Prijem ukazuje, kolik penez denne\rdostaneme z obsazenych mest.\f

en: Funds indicates how much money\ryou have right now.\f
cz: Finance ukazuji, kolik penez\rprave ted mas.\f

en: This is the status of your\rOrange Star army.\f
cz: Tohle je stav tve\rarmady Orange Star.\f

en: But you don't know about the\rBlue Moon army, do you?\fThe Fog of War prevents you from\rseeing what the enemy is doing.\f
cz: O armade Blue Moon ale\rnic nevis, ze?\fMlha valky ti brani videt,\rco nepritel dela.\f

en: That's all there is to say about that.\fChoose another menu.\f
cz: K tomu uz neni co dodat.\fVyber jinou nabidku.\f

en: In that case, try something else.\f
cz: Tak zkus neco jineho.\f

en: Ah, yes, the deployment menu.\fYour bases are where all of your\rland units have been deployed.\fThe number next to each unit is the\rcost of deploying that unit.\fIf it costs less than your total funds,\ryou can deploy the unit.\fAlso, because there are so many land\runits, they might not fit on one page.\fUse the + Control Pad to scroll to\rthe very bottom of the page.\fThat's right. You can use the units\rone day after you deploy them.\fJust remember that the units wait\rthe first day you deploy them.\fYou'll probably wonder what units\ryou should produce first. Which one\fwas the easiest to use in your\fField Training? Focus on those\rfirst, then slowly deploy others.\f
cz: Ano, nabidka nasazeni.\fZe zakladen nasazujes\rvsechny pozemni jednotky.\fCislo vedle kazde jednotky je\rcena jejiho nasazeni.\fKdyz je nizsi nez tve finance,\rmuzes jednotku nasadit.\fPozemnich jednotek je hodne,\rtakze se nemusi vejit na stranku.\fOvladacim krizkem sjed az\ruplne na konec stranky.\fPresne tak. Jednotky muzes pouzit\rden po jejich nasazeni.\fPamatuj, ze prvni den\rpo nasazeni jednotky cekaji.\fAsi te napadne, ktere jednotky\rstavet prvni. Ktera se ti\fve Vycviku pouzivala nejlip?\fNa ty se zamer nejdriv\ra pak pomalu nasazuj dalsi.\f

en: Oh. Then choose something\relse.\f
cz: Aha. Tak vyber neco\rjineho.\f

en: OK--airport deployment...\fAirports are where you'll deploy\ryour air units from.\fThe number next to the unit is how\rmuch it costs to deploy the unit.\fIf it is less than your total funds,\ryou can deploy the unit.\fUse the + Control Pad to select a\runit.\fYou can't use them on the same day\ryou deploy them, though.\f
cz: Dobre -- nasazeni na letisti...\fZ letist nasazujes\rsvoje letecke jednotky.\fCislo vedle jednotky je cena\rjejiho nasazeni.\fKdyz je nizsi nez tve finance,\rmuzes jednotku nasadit.\fJednotku vyberes ovladacim\rkrizkem.\fVe stejny den, kdy je nasadis,\rje ale pouzit nemuzes.\f

en: Come back anytime you want\rto hear an explanation again!\f
cz: Vrat se kdykoli budes chtit\rvysvetleni slyset znovu!\f

en: Oh, port deployment...\fPorts are where you'll deploy\ryour sea units from.\fThe number next to the unit is how\rmuch it costs to deploy the unit.\fIf it is less than your total funds,\ryou can deploy the unit.\fUse the + Control Pad to select a\runit.\fYou can't use them on the same day\ryou deploy them, though.\f
cz: Aha, nasazeni v pristavu...\fZ pristavu nasazujes\rsvoje namorni jednotky.\fCislo vedle jednotky je cena\rjejiho nasazeni.\fKdyz je nizsi nez tve finance,\rmuzes jednotku nasadit.\fJednotku vyberes ovladacim\rkrizkem.\fVe stejny den, kdy je nasadis,\rje ale pouzit nemuzes.\f

en: Oh. Just ask me anytime you\rwant to hear it.\f
cz: Aha. Rekni si kdykoli,\rkdyz to budes chtit slyset.\f

en: Thanks for listening!\fI hope I'll see you again soon.\f
cz: Diky za pozornost!\fDoufam, ze se brzy uvidime.\f

en: Nell? Is that you?\rIs this a transceiver?\f
cz: Nell? To jsi ty?\rTohle je vysilacka?\f

en: That's right, Andy. I'll be using it to\rcontact you from here on out.\fAs this is your first real command,\rI wanted to check up on you.\f
cz: Presne tak, Andy. Odted se ti\rbudu ozyvat pres ni.\fJe to tve prvni skutecne veleni,\rtak jsem se chtela ozvat.\f

en: No worries here! This is\rgoing to be easy!\f
cz: Zadny strach! Tohle\rbude hracka!\f

en: Oh, Andy! You're nothing if\rnot enthusiastic.\fLet me give you a few\rwords of advice.\fFirst, let's talk about your\rCO Power.\f
cz: Ach, Andy! Nadseni ti\rrozhodne nechybi.\fDam ti par rad\rna cestu.\fNejdriv si promluvme\ro tve CO sile.\f
